Money in

Invoices that get themselves paid.

Quotes convert to invoices, invoices carry Stripe, GoCardless and Pay-by-Bank links, overdue ones chase politely, and incoming payments auto-match to the right invoice in your feed.

Payment links on every invoice. Card, Direct Debit or bank transfer — the client picks. Auto-reconciled. Money lands, the invoice is marked paid, the ledger posts itself. Overdue is visible. The amber week — money about to be late — gets its own signal, while chasing still helps.
